answer: 证据只能直接说明 ToG-2 一侧的机制，G-Retriever 一侧没有提供任何原文证据，因此无法比较两者差异。就 ToG-2 而言：它用知识图谱把文档按实体连接起来，从而进行深度且由知识引导的上下文检索，同时把文档当作实体上下文来实现精确高效的图检索，并在图检索与上下文检索之间交替寻找与问题相关的深入线索 [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]。它被描述为迭代地从非结构化与结构化知识源中紧耦合地检索信息 [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]，并通过 KG 与文本的迭代协作检索提升推理忠实性 [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]。关于实体与文档协作，ToG-2 利用 KG 通过实体链接文档，同时把文档作为实体上下文，并让图检索与上下文检索交替进行 [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]；它还把文本上下文用于可靠图检索，并通过 KG 实现知识引导的上下文检索，迭代执行合作式检索 [chunk_44ca1868cc8294f6cfe2d5991cbd0d4b]。输入规模问题方面，证据只提到现有基于 KG 或文本的 RAG 系统在处理复杂知识推理任务时难以确保深度知识检索 [chunk_44ca1868cc8294f6cfe2d5991cbd0d4b]，以及当前 RAG 方法往往无法保证检索信息的深度与完整性 [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]，没有给出具体输入规模数值，也没有 G-Retriever 的相关机制证据。结论：G-Retriever 与 ToG-2 在选择证据机制上的差异证据不足；仅能确认 ToG-2 的 KG×文本紧耦合、双向协作与迭代检索描述。

citations.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
citations.quote:
CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional
training costs.
